study.question: Which auxiliary tasks supply the observed context-mediated click benefit in the strongest joint model, and can a task-selective shared-gradient route improve click AUC while all four task losses, history inputs and private capacity remain intact?
study.hypothesis: Observed: baseline-din click AUC0.655544082420; imported g0-r0039-context_product and exact-objective g3-r0030-joint_replay both0.668457307891. g3-r0030-click_only and g3-r0030-aux_context_blocked both0.667854872059, with exactly equal reported click Logloss and history-slice metrics. The all-open benefit over blocked is0.000602435832. g3-r0030-aux_batch_roll yields0.667463946581; it preserves auxiliary label triple/marginals but may retain batch correlations. All runs succeeded; no failed scientific trajectory is supplied. The blocked and rolled branches are retained as negative alternatives, not erased. Provisional explanation: true auxiliary supervision changes shared context via the two adapter input edges, and tasks may differ in useful transfer versus interference. The existing experiment isolates the route but not per-task contribution or gradient direction. Opening only selected task edges may preserve beneficial transfer while avoiding harmful transfer, despite keeping every task privately trained. No evidence ranks cart, fav or buy in advance. Aggregate click equality is not proof of identical checkpoint tensors. This remains single-seed controlled evidence, not repeated support.

nearest_work.difference: Read the standalone source and supplied validation receipt. Inherit its explicit joint BCE hook, full representation, state updates and gradient ownership. Add only a per-label membership condition to the existing adapter-context detach. This is task-resolved attribution of the existing gate, not a new representation family.

Existing all-or-none gate blocks both context adapter inputs and exactly matches click-only aggregate/slice click metrics. New subsets locate task-specific participation while leaving the same private supervision trained.
Pinned primary upstream implementation lines85-92 sums four mean BCE terms; retain the previous explicit joint hook. No adaptive task weighting, new training recipe, or loss normalization change.

Primary text lines80-85 describes target-conditioned local activation and weighted behavior pooling. These are inherited, adapted components; task-resolved auxiliary context-gradient gating is an empirical extension of the local joint model, with no DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Pinned benchmark source lines123-170 uses task-specific sequence-mask hubs, categorical/task tokens, stacked exchange and task towers. Our intervention only selects backward edges in the inherited compressed-history model and introduces no task hubs/broadcasts or new forward task routing. Original paper text unavailable through the authorized reader; fallback benchmark section2.3 was read. Original-paper priority/equivalence remains unverified.

Pinned benchmark forward lines117-145 shares a sparse-filtered bottom representation among towers. We do not add activation sparsity or sparse filtering; an existing stop-gradient selects which private tasks train shared context. Benchmark source inspection does not validate original-paper claims.

inherited_components: Every learned module and initialization from g3-r0030-joint_replay / g0-r0039-context_product, including field embeddings, target/action-aware local activation and native Dice state.

Frozen ten-block compressed histories, primary/feedback readouts, target-match and ordinal/quadratic summaries, folded training support, pruned evaluation, task-specific residual adapters and rank16 context/history product fusion.

Shared scorer/item/action blocking, blocked direct auxiliary tower-context edge, primary auxiliary normalization populations, all four private towers and the identical explicit joint true-label BCE hook.
study.proposed_difference: One model argument auxiliary_context_tasks (literal list in CONFIG, immutable tuple internally) selects auxiliary labels whose context edge into BOTH existing residual and product-query adapters remains attached during training. The other auxiliary tasks see numerically identical detached context and retain all private parameter gradients and full true-label BCE. Existing global block_aux_adapter_context_grad takes precedence. Four prospective subsets are {cart}, {fav}, {buy}, {fav,buy}; all and empty endpoints reuse matching prior joint/blocked controls. Same forward values at fixed weights, module/state initialization, capacity, losses, historical feedback and evaluation policy. No surrogate VJP, gradient projection, task weighting, data filtering or adaptive label selection. At most these two nested 2x2 performance contrasts are identified; a full three-task factorial is not. Local verification completed: all four sources compile without imports; supplied study-schema constraints were checked recursively with the standard library; literal CONFIG matches constructor defaults and proposal configs; imports/direct calls satisfy the declared ownership boundary; normalizing only the new metadata validation, argument/config, module documentation and membership condition restores the exact joint_replay AST. Every read-only ancestor and baseline digest matches the resolved receipts. These are static observations, not tensor/mechanism/performance results. torch and jsonschema are absent; no package was installed. The task-named validate_task.py could not be resolved (Unknown authorized reference), so no official validator ran. This unavailable interface is distinct from experimental failure and its attempt/preparation still consumes wall-clock budget. Only resolve/read/search are exposed by tools.py; no writable memory interface is exposed, so evidence-linked observations are preserved prospectively here for host ingestion rather than writing the read-only evidence/knowledge sources.
predictions: Host endpoint preflight: at identical weights every subset has equal four-task train/eval probabilities and Dice updates. The all/empty metadata settings reproduce the corresponding existing open/blocked gradients; all new variants preserve private learning for all four tasks.

If task contributions differ, at least one singleton-vs-blocked contrast or one grouped factorial contrast will differ from the others reproducibly. The ordering is deliberately unspecified before measurement.

If one task is interfering, excluding its context transfer can improve over all-open without removing historical feedback or its private true-label training. If tasks cooperate, all-open or fav+buy may outperform its component singletons.

Parameter counts are unchanged by construction; inference operations are unchanged and timing differences should be treated as measurement noise unless repeated. Any training cost change must be measured, not inferred as acceleration.

Explore the existing predefined empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history slices; no promised benefit on empty histories because the adapter contribution is multiplied by has_history. Report train-defined hour/frequency/behavior/missing-field slices only when supplied by the authorized scorer; do not invent inputs or claim unavailable diagnostics.
falsifiers: A fixed-state forward/state discrepancy or unexpected shared-parameter gradient path fails implementation isolation and must be corrected before interpreting any training score; this is an implementation failure, not scientific disproof.

No reproducible subset variation beyond paired uncertainty falsifies meaningful task heterogeneity at the tested exposure. No subset exceeding all-open falsifies the proposed selective-transfer improvement in this setting while allowing a mechanistic attribution result.

No singleton benefit over blocked does not alone refute useful auxiliary supervision: fav+buy/all-open cooperation must be evaluated. Conversely a surviving useful singleton does not establish gradient conflict among the others.

If a nominated task subset loses its advantage on permitted paired repetitions or matches an information-destroying replacement, retain a null/optimization explanation; do not claim informative task-specific transfer or a general method.
If the all-open gain over blocked does not repeat on permitted paired seeds, revise the prior utility explanation as seed-sensitive. This propose phase cannot execute seeds or change the frozen seed.
alternative_explanations: Single frozen seed and one pass; old controls are matched deterministic runs, not independent repetitions. No confidence/significance claim from these points.

Different allowed task subsets change shared gradient magnitude as well as label-specific information, sparse Adagrad accumulators and later optimization trajectories. AUC differences alone cannot establish gradient alignment or distinguish helpful signal from task-dependent regularization.

Global dense clipping and shared-table aliases could couple otherwise detached paths; require host ownership checks and inspect clipping if that diagnostic is available. The previous click-only/blocked equality limits this concern for that run but does not prove all settings.

AUC factorial interactions describe nonadditivity of trained performance, not instantaneous gradient inner products; repeated-user dependence requires paired user-cluster uncertainty where the host exposes validation predictions.

These auxiliary labels concern the same user/category/brand over24h, not ad-specific conversion attribution. Category/brand association or calibration could mediate transfer; no causal conversion explanation is supported.

Private head changes and representation drift can affect later gradients despite identical starting values. A selective-routing win alone does not prove instantaneous negative cosine or gradient interference.

Selection among four subsets uses the same validation set and invites selection bias. Nominate with validation, confirm via the authorized repetition phase, freeze the suite before withheld assessment and keep closed outcomes out of open memory.
Whole-window filtering/static snapshots and official_offline action visibility are inherited offline limitations; no production point-in-time validity claim follows.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Task-specific information exchange is relevant context, but the observed unresolved limitation is auxiliary backward ownership in an already strong local model. Pinned benchmark forward and fallback section2.3 were inspected; original-paper full text is unavailable.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None imported from this card; the experimental change derives from local joint/blocked/click-only/rolled outcomes.
